function.description: From and to dates and a label for a period word, from today's date.

function.name: calculate
function.description: Exact sum, difference (first minus second), average, percent_of (first as a percent of second), change_percent (from first to second), percent_more or percent_less (that percent added or taken off) of figures already read for this question or numbers from it. rows.* takes every row of a result, only when all its rows were sent. Gives the result with its side or dir, checked when all inputs are, and the working.

inputs.description: Paths such as r3.balance, r4.rows.*.balance or q.n1; for percent_more and percent_less: the amount, then q.n1, only in an agar or if question with one percent number

function.name: estimate
function.description: An estimate of the months ahead from the full months in the books, by same pace, same growth and, with 12 months, same season; and the month a target is passed. `until` year_end gives the whole year: the books' months so far (`year.so_far`) plus the months to December; each method has `year_total`; no `target` with it. `head` (shop_expenses) is one expense head, `partner` (profit) one partner's share; a filter a measure does not take is refused. A balance (`party_balance` with `party`, `cash_in_hand`, `buyers_dues`) is `now` from the books plus the average change of a month times the months: same pace only, `same_pace.total` after `ahead` months; no `until`, `what_if` or `target`.

ahead.description: Months ahead, 1 to 12: a question number with unit months; with none, 6, or 12 for a target; null with until

until.description: Only when the question says to the end of the year

what_if.description: Only when the question asks agar or if and names it

percent.description: For up and down: the percent number of the question (q.n1)

party.description: party_balance: a find match, never چکتا کھاتہ
